subject.title: fix(onboarding): leave session.dmScope unset so the personal-agent default "main" applies

question: Should fresh local onboarding deliberately use the shared personal-agent `main` DM session by leaving `session.dmScope` unset, with isolation remaining opt-in for shared inboxes?
rationale: The code follows the described schema/default contract, but selecting the default changes the context-isolation boundary for every new local installation; protected security and maintainer labels require an explicit human decision.

options.title: Confirm the personal-agent default
options.body: Approve leaving `dmScope` unset for new local setups, provided the multi-user isolation guidance and audit path remain documented.

options.title: Keep isolated onboarding
options.body: Retain `per-channel-peer` as the onboarding default if safety for shared inboxes should outweigh cross-channel personal-agent continuity.

recommendation.title: Confirm the personal-agent default
recommendation.body: Approve leaving `dmScope` unset for new local setups, provided the multi-user isolation guidance and audit path remain documented.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR body attributes the default posture to an owner decision, making this the strongest available routing signal in the supplied evidence.
